paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 1:13, speaking in R' Yitzchak’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Heading Tuviah and body Yitzchak both have abbreviated titles, retained as R'. Chapter 1, section 13 is a conventional reading of פ״א-יג, without a verified modern verse mapping or named edition.
